name: Pusher
tagline: Hosted WebSocket-based real-time messaging and presence for apps
description: Pusher is a hosted real-time communication platform that provides Channels (WebSocket pub/sub with presence and client events), Beams (push notifications), and related SDKs. Developers publish events from servers via a REST API and subscribe from clients over WebSockets. Common for live dashboards, chat, collaborative apps, and notifications without running your own WebSocket infrastructure.

auth.details: Server REST uses HMAC-SHA256 signed requests with app_id, key, and secret (auth_key, auth_timestamp, auth_version, body_md5, auth_signature query params). Client libraries use app key; private/presence channels use endpoint auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — verify current plan limits on pricing page

use_cases: publish a real-time event to a channel from a server
build live chat or presence indicators with WebSockets
trigger client UI updates without polling
authenticate private or presence channel subscriptions
